name: Night Class
summary: A course progress card where each finished lesson lights a star and joins a constellation
about: A course card with a night sky beside the lesson checklist. Every lesson is a star: finish one and it charges up, flares and draws a golden line to the star before it, while the progress ring and bar roll forward. When all eight are done the stars form The Paper Kite, a shooting star crosses, gold confetti falls and a certificate slides up that you can really download.
how: Press Resume: the current lesson plays on a quick timer and its star slowly charges.
When the lesson ends it ticks itself, the star flares and a line draws to the last one.
Tick or untick any lesson by hand; open and close the modules with their headers.
Finish all eight lessons to complete the constellation and get the certificate.
Download the certificate as an SVG file, go back to the course or restart it.
